Page65 of158 T-RICH Pre-FEED Report – Public Version Figure 4.12: T-RICH Plot Plan 4.5.2 CO STORAGE TANKS 2 During the Pre-FEED phase, it was determined that selecting 11 horizontal pressure vessels reduces the risk of potential CO leak paths, minimizes connecting pipework, and simplifies installation from a 2 construction perspective. The initial plan of using 36 vertical tanks posed higher risks of leak paths and greater complexity in piping and constructability. Therefore, the 11 horizontal units have been chosen and are located on the southern side of the site facility. Page66 of158 T-RICH Pre-FEED Report – Public Version The CO storage units are arranged parallel to each other, simplifying piping arrangements by maintaining 2 symmetry in the piping to and from each pressure vessel. This layout also allows for flexibility in piping to reduce stress within pipe routes and at vessel nozzle locations. Common pipe racks or sleeper supports can be used for two or more adjacent units. Multiple pressure relief systems will be located at the upper level of the tanks, and this arrangement will simplify the design of elevated access platforms, providing common access points for multiple adjacent tanks. Fig. 4.13 shows the CO storage units with pipe racks 2 between adjacent tanks. Figure 4.13: T-RICH Storage Tank Arrangement 4.5.3 COMPRESSION AND LIQUEFACTION There are two 50% trains of compression and liquefaction located north of the CO storage tank area. 2 Each train includes a three-stage compressor with 1st, 2nd, and 3rd stage inlet scrubbers and discharge fan coolers. To support modularization it has been assumed that the three stages of compression will be performed in a single unit with multiple compression stages driven from a single motor. Subsequent phases of the project will investigate integrally geared compressors and more traditional back to back stages. The Cold Recovery Heat Exchanger, LP, MP, and HP Flash Separators, along with the Stripper, Reflux Drum, Reboiler, and Condenser for each train, are situated just north of the compressors and scrubbers to ensure a sequential flow of the process, minimizing the need to reverse the process direction. The Liquid CO 2 transfer pumps to the storage tanks are located just west of the LP Flash Separator, beneath the Cooler Fan pipe rack area. Page67 of158 T-RICH Pre-FEED Report – Public Version A minimum spacing of 3 meters between equipment has been maintained to allow for piping, cable ways, instrumentation, maintenance access, and mobile equipment access if necessary. Some equipment, such as scrubbers, will have larger spacing to accommodate the required minimum inlet or outlet piping straight lengths for proper function. Certain equipment, like compressors, will require greater clearance for maintenance access, which has been accounted for in the layout.
